text: Figure 7.1: Network Topology Example The CanTSyn supports a fan-out of a given Time Base on several CAN busses in parallel. Those busses all belong to the same Time Domain. Note: A separate configuration container CanTSynGlobalTimeDomain needs to be configured for each CAN bus on which the CanTSyn transmits the Time Base for a given Time Domain - although those busses all belong to the same Time Domain. The protocol specification [1] Chapter “Time Master” specifies the protocol state ma- chine of a Time Master. The sections below specify details how the protocol state machine is realized in the CanTSyn module. Also refer to the sequence diagrams Figure 9.2 and Figure 9.3 for the interaction with other BSW modules during transmission of a SYNC/FUP message sequence.
